title: Web Summit to stay in Lisbon until 2028 as part of new 110m deal (The Irish Times)
what_it_says: The Irish Times reports a new 10-year deal between the company and the Portuguese government keeping Web Summit in Lisbon until at least 2028, worth 110 million euros, after a tender with offers from more than 20 cities, with 11 million euros a year paid to the company, a venue expansion and a 3 billion euro buyout clause.
status: publication date not shown on the page as fetched; the text says last year's event had more than 60,000 attendees and this year's was in November, placing it in an autumn before a Lisbon edition; not placed on the timeline
